title: Miami Mint Geek Bar Pulse X 25000
description:
Miami Mint Geek Bar Pulse X 25000
A Burst of Refreshing Flavor
Discover the Miami Mint Geek Bar Pulse X 25000 and take your vaping experience to new heights. This disposable vape delivers an irresistible burst of cooling mint with every inhale, perfectly balanced to provide a crisp, refreshing flavor that keeps you coming back for more.
Power-Packed Performance
With an impressive 25,000 puffs, the Geek Bar Pulse X ensures that your vaping sessions last longer than ever before. Whether you’re on a road trip, enjoying a night out, or relaxing at home, this powerhouse is designed to be your reliable companion. No refills, no charging, just uninterrupted vaping.
Sleek & Convenient Design
Designed for ultimate convenience, the Miami Mint Geek Bar Pulse X 25000 is compact, lightweight, and easy to carry. Its sleek design fits perfectly in your pocket or purse, while the ergonomic mouthpiece ensures every puff delivers comfort and satisfaction.
Made for Flavor Lovers
Experience mint like never before with this expertly crafted taste profile. The sharp, icy aroma combined with a silky smooth finish makes it the ideal choice for flavor enthusiasts seeking both freshness and finesse.
Key Features
Puff Count
:
Up to 25,000 (Regular Mode) or 15,000 (Pulse Mode)
E-liquid
:
18mL, 5% nicotine
Battery
:
820mAh rechargeable (USB-C)
Display
:
Smart 3D Curved LED Screen
Coils
:
Dual Mesh for superior flavor
Modes
:
Soft, Normal, Pulse
Airflow
:
Adjustable for customized draw
Start your refreshingly smooth vaping experience today with the Miami Mint Geek Bar Pulse X 25000!
